questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion in a condition that emphasizes the unexpectedness of the result?
options: Only when she had finished her work did he realise she was leaving.
Had she not been tired, she would have stayed longer.
If it were not for the rain, we would have gone camping.
No sooner had the meeting begun than the power failed.
questions.answer: Only when she had finished her work did he realise she was leaving.

questions.question: Which cleft sentence correctly restructures the following sentence to highlight the subject of the action: 'It was John who broke the vase.'
options: The vase was broken by John who did it.
Who broke the vase was John.
It was John that the vase was broken by him.
The action of breaking the vase was done by John.
questions.answer: Who broke the vase was John.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a third conditional with the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical situation in the past?
options: If she had studied harder, she would have passed the exam.
If she studies harder, she will pass the exam.
If she had studied harder, she would have passed the exam last year.
She would pass the exam if she studied harder now.
questions.answer: If she had studied harder, she would have passed the exam last year.

questions.question: Which sentence best demonstrates the use of ellipsis in a formal academic context, maintaining grammatical correctness and clarity?
options: After years of research, we concluded that the hypothesis was flawed, and we, therefore, abandoned it.
We concluded that the hypothesis was flawed; therefore, we abandoned it.
The hypothesis was flawed; we abandoned it after years of research.
Years of research showed the hypothesis was flawed, so we abandoned it.
questions.answer: After years of research, we concluded that the hypothesis was flawed, and we, therefore, abandoned it.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a nuanced formal register with a complex conditional structure to express a hypothetical scenario involving moral or ethical considerations?
options: Had he been given the opportunity, he would have spoken out against the injustice.
If he had been given the opportunity, he would speak out against the injustice.
He would have spoken out against the injustice if he had been given the opportunity to do so.
Given the opportunity, he would speak out against the injustice.
questions.answer: Had he been given the opportunity, he would have spoken out against the injustice.
